fusions.name: Split Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges a double point into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 70% of that damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Two-Way Thrust
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 4 tiles away, then kicks with two points for 13 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Other Branch
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Crossroads Gait
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage. Once every 6 seconds.
